title: Design tokens with contrast and scale checks
acceptance: Unit tests over tokens.css prove contrast in light, dark and high contrast, the spacing, radius, shadow and motion scales, the 72ch measure, and that no stylesheet uses gradients, glass or blur

title: Core components and Storybook catalogue
acceptance: Radix-based Button, Field, Dialog, Menu, Drawer, Tabs, Table, Toast and status components in packages/ui with stories in three themes; storybook builds; reduced motion makes transitions 0 s

title: Static export, headers and repo rules
acceptance: Repo-rule tests: output export, no dynamic segments, route handlers, middleware or server actions; vercel.json headers; query keys carry orgId; renovate config; CI workflow; jsx-no-literals active

title: API conventions: errors, server time, schemas, CORS, logs, shutdown
acceptance: Integration tests: one error shape, X-Server-Time on every response, every route declares request and response schemas and output is stripped, CORS only for configured origins, logs carry requestId, orgId and route with emails hashed, SIGTERM drains in-flight requests

title: Token verification and session bootstrap
acceptance: Bootstrap resolves super admin, then admin, then whitelist and sets claims; requests without a valid token get 401; revoked tokens are refused on admin mutations; org comes from the claim or X-Org-Id for super admins

title: Tenancy guards and route-table checks
acceptance: Admin guard allows admin of the org or super admin with X-Org-Id; org B resources are 404 for org A admins; a route-table test calls every admin route with both tokens; data-access functions take orgId first

title: Feature flags, limits and usage counters
acceptance: resolveEntitlements order unit-tested; a gated route returns 403 FEATURE_DISABLED; monthly counters increment atomically and refuse at the limit; entitlements cached 60 s against the clock

title: Audit writer
acceptance: Audit entries carry actor, org, action, target, before and after without sensitive fields, IP, user agent and request ID, written in the same batch as the change; no route edits or deletes them

title: Security rules and platform infrastructure
acceptance: Rules tests deny every client access to Firestore and Storage; infrastructure items are owner checks in MANUAL_CHECKS.md

title: Google sign-in and role landing
acceptance: E2E: each role signs in through the Auth emulator and lands on its home; an unlisted account sees the contact message; a student opening an admin URL is sent back to the student home

title: Organizations console
acceptance: Super admin creates, edits, suspends, archives and restores organizations; duplicate slug refused next to the field; suspended org users cannot sign in; archived org is read-only

title: Organization admins
acceptance: Super admin adds an admin by email who then signs in to the admin workspace; removing them revokes tokens and access ends

title: Entitlements, locked features and usage
acceptance: Super admin toggles flags and limits with audit before and after; disabled features show locked in the org UI and return 403 even for super admins; usage against limits shown

title: Organization switcher and workspace banner
acceptance: Super admin enters an org's admin workspace from the sidebar switcher; a banner names the org; actions are audit-logged with the super admin as actor

title: Admin shell, navigation and command palette
acceptance: Sidebar, top bar and page header; skip link, landmarks and heading order; visible focus ring; 44 px targets; Ctrl K palette and ? shortcuts; sidebar icons below 1,200 px; works at 768 px

title: Departments
acceptance: Admin adds, renames, archives and merges departments; a department in use cannot be deleted; renames show everywhere

title: Whitelist upload wizard
acceptance: CSV, XLSX, paste and single add with column mapping and preview; validation report of invalid, duplicate, existing and over-limit entries before saving; emails stored lowercase

title: Whitelist list and bulk actions
acceptance: Whitelist shows invited, registered and disabled; bulk disable, enable, remove and export; cursor pagination with a 200 maximum

title: Student sign-in, org choice and consent
acceptance: A student in two orgs picks one; first sign-in shows the consent notice; the uid is linked to the student record created by the whitelist or manual add

title: Profile completion and locking
acceptance: First sign-in requires name, PRN, department and graduation year; whitelist PRN prefilled and locked; duplicate PRN refused; profile lock shows read-only; the admin lock toggle is optimistic and rolls back on refusal

title: Student directory and detail
acceptance: Search, filters, sort, column picker, density; row opens a 560 px drawer; edit, disable, delete (typed confirmation when results exist) and manual add, all audit-logged

title: Audit log screens
acceptance: Admin sees own org's log, super admin sees all orgs, with filters by actor, action, target, organization and date, and CSV export

title: Accessibility panel and preferences
acceptance: Panel in every top bar sets text size, theme, high contrast, motion, spacing and reading ruler; saved to the account and applied before first paint

title: Eligibility and marks logic
acceptance: Unit tests: eligibility needs registered status and matching rules, empty rules mean no restriction, tests only narrow; pool draw counts; marks resolve question, section, test

title: Series with defaults and eligibility
acceptance: Admin creates a series with dates, default settings and eligibility; live matching count opens the list; the flexible full-review combination is blocked with a reason; students only see active series

title: Tests and the series timeline
acceptance: Admin adds tests with company, day number (suggested, renamable, hideable) and scheduled date; the series page shows a day-by-day timeline; times show the org timezone

title: Inherited and overridden settings
acceptance: Each test setting shows Inherited or Overridden with a reset to the series value

title: Question editor and JSON import
acceptance: Admin writes and edits questions with a live student preview (KaTeX MathML, code, images with alt text), reorders by drag or keyboard, and imports the legacy JSON format

title: Sections, pools, difficulty mix, marking and timers
acceptance: Admin configures sections, draw counts, difficulty mixes (blocked when unsatisfiable), marking presets and per-question time limits

title: Test preview
acceptance: Preview opens the real exam screen with no attempt, no proctoring and a show-answers toggle

title: Approval checklist and publishing
acceptance: Approve runs the checklist; only approved tests publish ("Test published") and get a settings snapshot; edits before attempts return the test to in review

title: Super-admin authoring parity
acceptance: Super admin creates and publishes a series and test in org A's workspace, logged with them as actor

title: Timing and scoring logic
acceptance: Unit tests: start windows and deadlines for each timing mode, section timers inside the deadline, scoring with negatives, passing marks, unanswered 0 and optional floor

title: Student dashboard and test page
acceptance: Dashboard lists live, upcoming and completed eligible tests with window, duration, countdown and timezone

title: Attempt start and resume API
acceptance: POST /attempts checks eligibility and window, draws once with a seeded order, fixes the deadline, schedules auto-submit and returns one payload without answers; repeats and Idempotency-Key replay the same attempt; locked settings refuse edits

title: Preflight and rules screens
acceptance: Preflight shows each check with a fix line and loads the face model; rules screen shows duration, deadline, strikes, marking, sections and privacy note; Start needs passing checks and agreement

title: Exam screen, palette and navigation
acceptance: Answer sheet with bubble options, timing track and palette states with shape and labels; mark, clear, jump; keyboard shortcuts; resume after closing the tab; palette drawer below 1,280 px

title: Exam timer and announcements
acceptance: Timer uses the server offset; visual and polite announcements at 10, 5 and 1 minutes; T speaks the remaining time

title: Offline autosave and answer sync
acceptance: IndexedDB first, batched sync with sequence numbers, backoff, sync indicator, late sync within 2 minutes, one record per answer, backlog and offset reported, rate limits

title: Submit, auto-submit and grading
acceptance: Submit summary flushes then submits; offline submit retries; the auto-submit task finalizes at the deadline idempotently and reschedules; grading uses the stored draw and queues a leaderboard

title: Per-question timers
acceptance: Timed questions lock and advance when time ends, navigation is forward-only, and the server rejects answers after the limit plus 2 s

title: Proctoring events and strikes API
acceptance: Events within 3 s count once, strikes increment in a transaction, the maximum terminates and grades, and every event is logged and listed

title: Browser lockdown and strike warnings
acceptance: Fullscreen exit, tab switch and blur record strikes with an acknowledged warning ("Strike 1 of 3"); devtools policy; copy, paste, print and selection blocked

title: Laptop camera proctoring
acceptance: Self-hosted MediaPipe face detection runs on the device; no face past the grace period strikes; the preview collapses but the camera stays on

title: Phone pairing and presence
acceptance: QR pairing link valid 5 minutes and single use; device custom token; phone heartbeats and camera; laptop overlay after 15 s and strike after 60 s; RTDB rules; outage suspends phone strikes

title: Leaderboard ranking logic
acceptance: Unit tests: test and series ranking with shared ranks, missed tests as 0, terminated excluded, board size and paging

title: Result release modes and withdrawal
acceptance: Immediate, after window close (scheduled task), manual and never release behave as configured; withdrawal shows "Results are being reviewed"

title: Result page and full review
acceptance: Released result shows score, out of, percentage, rank, sections, time and strikes; full review shows answers, key, marks and explanations; terminated attempts show their reason

title: Student history
acceptance: History by series and day with scores only where allowed

title: Leaderboards
acceptance: Boards recomputed at most every 30 s and on release, visible only when enabled and released; students see top 50 plus their highlighted row; admins see all

title: Results exports
acceptance: Test and series exports in CSV and XLSX with every column, built in the worker, downloaded through a 15-minute signed link, audit-logged

title: Live dashboard and RTDB mirror
acceptance: Live counts and roster from the RTDB mirror update within 5 s, with filters and sorting; only that org's admins can read it

title: Extra time and student signals
acceptance: Grant moves the deadline, reschedules auto-submit, updates the student timer with a notice within 5 s, needs a second confirmation above 100%, and is audit-logged

title: Standing accommodations
acceptance: Per-student extra percentage or minutes per series applies automatically at start

title: Reset, terminate, reinstate and event timeline
acceptance: Row actions open the timeline, terminate with reason, reinstate, and reset with a reason (old attempt archived, fresh draw)

title: Screenshot tests, pre-warming and exam-day runbook
acceptance: Screenshot tests of exam, result, live dashboard and test editor in three themes; prewarm task; runbook; owner load test and monitoring checks

title: Question checks and LLM instructions
acceptance: Unit tests: every IMP-09 check with plain reasons; the prompt keeps wording, never invents answers, and treats file content as data

title: Import upload and job API
acceptance: Signed upload and job creation; format and size limits by file signature; AI imports count against the monthly limit

title: Worker extraction pipeline
acceptance: Worker parses JSON and template sheets directly and sends PDF pages, TXT and MD to the LLM through the AI SDK; figures cropped; provider, model, tokens and cost logged; LLM failures retry

title: Import review screen
acceptance: Live job progress that survives closing the tab; flagged questions grouped with reasons; source page beside the question; approve, edit, discard and approve-all; keyboard shortcuts

title: Analytics metrics
acceptance: Unit tests for every metric, including the discrimination index and series trends

title: AI summary check and PDF report
acceptance: Summary from metrics JSON only, rejected when it contains a number not in the metrics; PDF rendered with headless Chromium plus optional XLSX

title: Report gating, limits and listing
acceptance: Reports locked when the feature is off, counted against the monthly limit, listed for download

title: Accessibility statement and screen-reader pass
acceptance: Public accessibility statement page with standard, known gaps and contact; screen-reader passes are owner checks

title: Migrations runner and release operations
acceptance: Versioned migrations run through /tasks/migrate idempotently; deploy freeze, rollback and the deploy pipeline are owner checks
